_comment: Weight manifest. Each repo is pinned to a Hugging Face revision; scripts/download_models.py
fetches only the files listed in `files` (glob patterns) into models/<name> (gitignored), and
models.lock.json pins every file's size and SHA256. Weights are NOT redistributed by this repo:

repos.name: sa3-medium
repos.role: engine: Stable Audio 3 Medium (44.1 kHz stereo, up to 380 s, 8 steps)
repos.licence: Stability AI Community License (+ Gemma Terms for T5Gemma)

repos.name: sa3-small-music
repos.role: optional engine: Stable Audio 3 Small-Music (44.1 kHz stereo, up to 120 s; shares Medium's text encoder)
repos.licence: Stability AI Community License (+ Gemma Terms for T5Gemma)

repos.name: clap
repos.role: check: CLAP text-audio similarity (music, speech and sounds; larger_clap_music's text tower is broken: every text embeds the same)

repos.name: aesthetics
repos.role: check: Meta Audiobox Aesthetics (enjoyment, usefulness, complexity, production quality)
